Pablo (ML Eng): Hi all — first day, accepted the org invite and SSO. Trying to push a small hotfix to `redwood-inference/model-registry` but `git push` errors out: 
```
remote: error: GH006: Protected branch update failed for refs/heads/main.
remote: error: At least 1 approving review is required by reviewers with write access.
To https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-registry.git
 ! [remote rejected] main -> main (protected branch hook declined)
error: failed to push some refs to 'https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-registry.git'
```
I only wanted to push a tiny doc change — who can help me get write perms or explain the PR flow?
Tara (Platform): Welcome Pablo! That message means branch protection requires PR + review (and maybe status checks). We generally don't allow direct pushes to main. You should open a PR from a feature branch. If you can't create branches, that's a perms issue. Can you `git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/pablo/short-doc` and paste any error?
Pablo (ML Eng): Tried creating a branch: `git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/pablo/docs-fix` gives `remote: Permission to redwood-inference/model-registry.git denied to pablo.` and 403. Weird — I can view the repo but pushing is denied.
Omar (Security): Two separate things: branch protection policy (PRs required) and repo write permission. People Ops usually maps you to teams that grant write. @Zoey did Pablo's join add him to `ml-core`? Also confirm 2FA/SAML is green.
Zoey (People Ops): I onboarded Pablo and the invite was accepted, SSO authorized. But I see he's in `ml-viewers` not `ml-core` (we default new hires to viewer until they finish training).@Pablo if you need write earlier we can fast-track after a short security quiz.
Pablo (ML Eng): I wasn't aware of the training gating. Is the quiz the only blocker? I need to push a quick README tweak and a model card update.
Tara (Platform): For docs-only changes we have an exception: create a PR from your fork — that doesn't need write access. Steps: 1) Fork the repo, 2) push branch to fork, 3) open PR from fork to redwood-inference/model-registry:main. If you prefer direct team access, @Zoey can add you to ml-core with write rights.
Pablo (ML Eng): Ok trying fork flow now. Quick question — the repo has a CODEOWNERS file that requests `@ml-core` approval. If I open a PR from a fork will that block merge until a reviewer from ml-core approves?
Omar (Security): Yes, CODEOWNERS is enforced by branch protection. Fork PRs are fine, but someone in the codeowners team will need to approve. We'll auto-request reviews to the team when PR opened. If you need a faster path, ask a teammate for a quick review.
Pablo (ML Eng): Opening PR now — pinging @Tara for review. Thanks for clarifying.
gh-bot: PR created: redwood-inference/model-registry#412 by pablo — "docs: small model-card note" (checks: 2/2 passing)
Tara (Platform): Reviewing now — small nit, then I'll approve. Also Zoey: once Pablo finishes the onboarding checklist (security quiz + infra orientation) can we promote to ml-core?
Zoey (People Ops): Yes — I'll mark quiz completed after he confirms. @Pablo I'll DM the quiz link.
Pablo (ML Eng): PR merged! Thanks everyone. I completed the quiz, Zoey — feel free to promote me when convenient.
Zoey (People Ops): Promoted to ml-core and granted repo write (audit id: PROM-2026).
gh-bot: note: user pablo added to team ml-core (id: 3345).
Pablo (ML Eng): Confirmed I can push to feature branches and create branches directly. Closing the loop — happy to share feedback on the onboarding gating if helpful. :thumbsup:
